baseline: LiveKit credential contained lease identity and account metadata but no name claim; remote participant.name was empty and the voice UI rendered its fallback «Участник».
change: Each authorized credential request now selects the current users.display_name with its active voice lease, signs that value as the LiveKit name claim, and keeps the existing identity, account metadata and room-scoped grants.

checks.name: focused_go_tests
checks.detail: Tests first failed against the old three-argument signer and two-column lease, then passed. JWT payload decoding asserts the Unicode name claim; service and repository tests assert propagation and current users.display_name selection.

checks.name: real_multi_user_livekit_session
checks.detail: No two-user LiveKit room or deployed browser session was exercised for this change.

limitation: Participants already connected with a credential lacking name must reconnect after deployment. A profile rename while connected becomes visible to peers on the next credential and LiveKit reconnection.
